# EduLearn - Product Summary for LLMs

## Product Overview

EduLearn is a Web3-powered educational platform that combines AI tutoring, gamification, and blockchain-backed rewards.
It specializes in Web3 education while still supporting broader learning goals through AI roadmaps, quizzes, XP, and verifiable achievement tracking.

Tagline: Learn Web3 Smarter. Earn as You Go
Website: https://edulearn.fun

## Core Features

### AI-Powered Learning
- AI tutor powered by Google Generative AI
- Interactive chat with conversation history
- Personalized learning roadmaps
- Quiz and flashcard generation for Web3 and broader skill development

### Gamification
- XP, streaks, leaderboards, and progress levels
- NFT achievement badges and certificates
- Reward loops designed to make consistent studying more motivating

### Web3 Rewards
- Wallet-connected rewards on web
- NFT badges as proof of work and proof of knowledge
- Solana-aligned learning and achievement verification

### Community
- Progress sharing and social motivation
- Leaderboards for friendly competition
- Learning paths that help users stay accountable

## Pricing

- Free: core AI learning features with daily limits
- Premium: advanced AI model access, higher limits, and additional learning tools

## Platform Availability

- Web (edulearn.fun): full feature set including wallet-connected rewards, NFTs, and verification
- Mobile (iOS/Android): core learning, quizzes, roadmaps, communities, and premium features

## Technical Stack

- API: NestJS, PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM)
- Web: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS
- Mobile: Expo React Native
- Auth: Supabase and OAuth providers
- AI: Google Generative AI (Gemini)

## Target Audience

- Web3 learners
- Blockchain developers
- Solana enthusiasts
- Students and general learners who want AI-guided study with gamified rewards

## Use Cases

Web3 onboarding, Solana learning, AI tutoring, quiz-based learning, verifiable skill badges, community learning, earn-while-learning study loops, proof-of-work education.

## Keywords

Web3 education, blockchain learning platform, Solana learning app, AI tutor, gamified learning, NFT certificates, crypto rewards, personalized learning roadmaps, AI-powered education, learn to earn, Web3 study companion, proof-of-work learning
